verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect hooks for surfacing intermediate agent activity. Step callbacks run on each step (though they are documented for modifying memory), agents can be run one step at a time with agent.step(), and runs are instrumented with OpenTelemetry. A developer could push per-step events to a UI with these, but nothing documents real-time streaming to a UI. Missing for 10: token-level LLM output streaming, a documented streaming API for tool-call and step events, UI integration examples, and independent corroboration.
